Customization.description: AesthetikContainers — PO arrival dates, container tracking, vessel tracking. Replaces IIGCONTAINERMGMT + IIGHFContainerMods.

Sql.Name: AesthetikContainers_Columns_v1
Sql.CDATA:
-- POOrder arrival + container fields IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POOrder') AND name = 'UsrExpArrivalDate') ALTER TABLE POOrder ADD UsrExpArrivalDate datetime NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POOrder') AND name = 'UsrActArrivalDate') ALTER TABLE POOrder ADD UsrActArrivalDate datetime NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POOrder') AND name = 'UsrContainerRef') ALTER TABLE POOrder ADD UsrContainerRef nvarchar(50) NULL; -- POLine arrival fields IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POLine') AND name = 'UsrExpArrivalDate') ALTER TABLE POLine ADD UsrExpArrivalDate datetime NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POLine') AND name = 'UsrActArrivalDate') ALTER TABLE POLine ADD UsrActArrivalDate datetime NULL; -- InventoryItem tariff + trade fields IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('InventoryItem') AND name = 'UsrHTSCode') ALTER TABLE InventoryItem ADD UsrHTSCode nvarchar(12) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('InventoryItem') AND name = 'UsrDutyRate') ALTER TABLE InventoryItem ADD UsrDutyRate decimal(19,4) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('InventoryItem') AND name = 'UsrCountryOfOrigin') ALTER TABLE InventoryItem ADD UsrCountryOfOrigin nchar(2) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('InventoryItem') AND name = 'UsrFiberContent') ALTER TABLE InventoryItem ADD UsrFiberContent nvarchar(100) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('InventoryItem') AND name = 'UsrPreferentialTariff') ALTER TABLE InventoryItem ADD UsrPreferentialTariff bit NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('InventoryItem') AND name = 'UsrFreightClass') ALTER TABLE InventoryItem ADD UsrFreightClass nvarchar(10) NULL; -- POReceiptLine landed cost fields IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POReceiptLine') AND name = 'UsrActualDutyAmt') ALTER TABLE POReceiptLine ADD UsrActualDutyAmt decimal(19,2) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POReceiptLine') AND name = 'UsrActualFreightAmt') ALTER TABLE POReceiptLine ADD UsrActualFreightAmt decimal(19,2) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POReceiptLine') AND name = 'UsrBrokerageAmt') ALTER TABLE POReceiptLine ADD UsrBrokerageAmt decimal(19,2) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POReceiptLine') AND name = 'UsrHTSCode') ALTER TABLE POReceiptLine ADD UsrHTSCode nvarchar(12) NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('POReceiptLine') AND name = 'UsrCountryOfOrigin') ALTER TABLE POReceiptLine ADD UsrCountryOfOrigin nchar(2) NULL; -- SOShipment container fields (replaces IIG UsrIGCMIncludeInContainer) IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('SOShipment') AND name = 'UsrIncludeInContainer') ALTER TABLE SOShipment ADD UsrIncludeInContainer bit NULL DEFAULT 0; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('SOShipment') AND name = 'UsrContainerID') ALTER TABLE SOShipment ADD UsrContainerID int NULL; -- BAccount (Vendor) container defaults (replaces IIG UsrIGCMDefaultInTransitSiteID) IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('BAccount') AND name = 'UsrDefaultInTransitSiteID') ALTER TABLE BAccount ADD UsrDefaultInTransitSiteID int NULL; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('BAccount') AND name = 'UsrDefaultCarrierCode') ALTER TABLE BAccount ADD UsrDefaultCarrierCode nvarchar(20) NULL;
-- ── Container Tracking Tables ──────────────────────────────────────── IF OBJECT_ID('UsrContainer', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [UsrContainer] ( CompanyID int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ContainerID int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, ContainerCD nvarchar(20) NOT NULL, CarrierCode nvarchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OTHER', BookingRef nvarchar(50) NULL, BillOfLading nvarchar(50) NULL, VesselName nvarchar(50) NULL, VesselIMO nvarchar(10) NULL, VoyageNbr nvarchar(30) NULL, PortOfLoading nvarchar(10) NULL, PortOfDischarge nvarchar(10) NULL, ETD datetime NULL, ATD datetime NULL, ETA datetime NULL, ATA datetime NULL, Status nvarchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BOOKED', ContainerType nvarchar(10) NULL, SealNbr nvarchar(20) NULL, LastEventCode nvarchar(20) NULL, LastEventDate datetime NULL, LastSyncDate datetime NULL, NoteID uniqueidentifier NULL, CreatedByID uniqueidentifier NULL, CreatedByScreenID char(8) NULL, CreatedDateTime datetime NULL, LastModifiedByID uniqueidentifier NULL, LastModifiedByScreenID char(8) NULL, LastModifiedDateTime datetime NULL, tstamp timestamp NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_UsrContainer PRIMARY KEY (CompanyID, ContainerID) ); IF OBJECT_ID('UsrContainerEvent', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [UsrContainerEvent] ( CompanyID int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, EventID int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, ContainerID int NOT NULL, CarrierEventCode nvarchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', NormalizedEventCode nvarchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', EventDateTime datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(), EventClassifier nvarchar(10) NULL, LocationName nvarchar(100) NULL, LocationCode nvarchar(10) NULL, VesselName nvarchar(50) NULL, Description nvarchar(255) NULL, RawPayload nvarchar(MAX) NULL, CreatedDateTime datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(), CONSTRAINT PK_UsrContainerEvent PRIMARY KEY (CompanyID, EventID) ); IF OBJECT_ID('UsrContainerPOLink', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [UsrContainerPOLink] ( CompanyID int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, LinkID int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, ContainerID int NOT NULL, OrderType nvarchar(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RO', OrderNbr nvarchar(15) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', LineNbr int NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_UsrContainerPOLink PRIMARY KEY (CompanyID, LinkID) ); -- Container tracking indexes IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('UsrContainer') AND name = 'IX_UsrContainer_ContainerCD') CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_UsrContainer_ContainerCD] ON [UsrContainer] (CompanyID, ContainerCD); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('UsrContainer') AND name = 'IX_UsrContainer_Status') CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_UsrContainer_Status] ON [UsrContainer] (CompanyID, Status); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('UsrContainerEvent') AND name = 'IX_UsrContainerEvent_ContainerID') CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_UsrContainerEvent_ContainerID] ON [UsrContainerEvent] (CompanyID, ContainerID, EventDateTime DESC); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('UsrContainerPOLink') AND name = 'IX_UsrContainerPOLink_ContainerID') CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_UsrContainerPOLink_ContainerID] ON [UsrContainerPOLink] (CompanyID, ContainerID); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('UsrContainerPOLink') AND name = 'IX_UsrContainerPOLink_PO') CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_UsrContainerPOLink_PO] ON [UsrContainerPOLink] (CompanyID, OrderType, OrderNbr);
